verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU platform and its software stack, since drivers, runtimes and tooling could collect usage data. The evidence pack never mentions vendor telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. ROCm being open source and the Device Metrics Exporter and Omnistat monitoring tools are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.
